description: Defines the visual style and writes the art bible: palette, shape language, rendering treatment, references, do and do-not rules. Written once and then cited by every art audit and generation run.
when_to_use: the visual style is undecided or inconsistent
the request asks what the game should look like
an art bible is missing or out of date
avoid_when: the style is already written down and the request is to produce assets
